obligation_accounting.what_these_mean: ACCOUNTED FOR is the weakest claim: the obligation's text lies inside the run-time partition and is claimed by some element, so nothing was dropped. REPRESENTED is stronger and is split in two, because a mechanic carried by a typed fact/component/qualifier and a mechanic carried by a prose binding are not the same achievement. CARRIED AS SUPPORTING AUTHORITY ONLY means the text was read and preserved but states no mechanic of its own. UNRESOLVED means read and deliberately not classified. The four buckets are disjoint and sum to the ledger.
obligation_accounting.not_claimed_by_this: that the typed representation of any obligation is complete, adequate for adjudication, or accepted. Bucketing states which vocabulary carries a clause, not that the clause is finished.

S-1.what_closed_it: representation schema 7 adds exactly one applicability kind, SPELL_CASTING_TIME, over exactly one closed value object, CastingTimeThreshold(at_least_amount, at_least_unit). No fact family, no ownership form, no predicate language, no executable rules engine, no invented source value. The schema-7 pin is 80e853ef9433ba2e7232c384a7192235692463c9954f5ff766be1fafade6f43d.
S-1.why_an_applicability_and_not_a_fact: K2's requirement and K4's consequences are two components of one record inside one printed condition. A gate carried as a FACT and restated on both components is refused by `_validate_duplicated_fact_authority` - one source statement would become two copies of the same authority. A repeated APPLICABILITY is admitted, because a condition two structures share is one condition. That asymmetry is the whole reason for the choice.
S-1.how_the_break_stays_conditional: a component carries exactly one `applies_when`, and the gate occupies it, so 'If your Concentration is broken' rides FactQualifier on each of the two consequence facts. Qualifiers compose conjunctively inward, which is the reading the source prints: a long casting, whose Concentration is broken.
S-1.what_is_still_deferred: general casting-time eligibility. SPELL_CASTING_TIME has one instance in one record, which is the weakest closure evidence known_unknowns.md admits, and the comparable-clause check that established the bounded vocabulary was scoped to casting-time eligibility rather than run as a corpus sweep. Recorded as narrowed, not discharged. Separately, a round and a turn have no fixed length, so `casting_time_meets` refuses them explicitly rather than answering; no SRD casting time is printed in either, so nothing in this batch is reached by that refusal.
S-1.a_one_minute_spell_falls_outside: Magic K1, NOT the Magic action. K1's eligibility fact says which spells the action REACHES by the cost they print; a timed casting prints no cost and so matches no eligibility fact. K2 is a different clause about a further requirement INSIDE that action.
